text:
sanjay: Heads-up: I'm drafting the prompt set for the next quant bakeoff (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ). Need quick decisions on sampling regimes, synthetic 'mixer' anchors, and per-deployment profiles. Sync in 10?

eva: :+1: I'm free. Quick take: tiered seed hierarchy — core factual, multi-turn chat threads, instruction-following, code snippets, and adversarial oddballs. For each tier produce 3 synthetic variants (paraphrase, truncation, punctuation/noise).

joel: How do we ensure distribution matches production? length / turns / perplexity buckets?

maria: We should sample anonymized traces from the last 30 days (call logs + SDK feedback) to derive length and token histograms, then oversample low-frequency intents (billing/legal/consent) for coverage.

joel: Also add a 'latency-boundary' slice: inputs that hit ~2x typical seq len so we exercise KV-cache and fallback routing.

david: Checklist proposal (quick):
1) derive real-dist histograms (len, turns, tokens, perplexity)
2) define tier weights and target counts per deployment profile
3) synth variants per seed (paraphrase / punctuation jitter / truncation / swap-nouns)
4) curated adversarial set (instructions that tend to break quantization)
5) holdout test set per model family + strict provenance tags
6) instrument delta metrics: EM, top-k accuracy, hallucination-flag rate, LLM-judged quality, and latency regressions

sanjay: Also recommend tagging each eval sample with a deployment_profile label: hosted-lowcost, dedicated-predictable, private-highprecision — different tolerance for delta.

eva: For metric calc specifically: compute accuracy delta per quant method (gptq / awq / int8 / fp8) vs fp32 baseline and produce stratified tables by tier + length bucket. Also track per-token hallucination indicator (binary) and median latency.

joel: Can we auto-generate paraphrases at scale? quick script idea: ```python
# naive paraphrase via small T5 for augmentation
from transformers import pipeline
parap = pipeline('text2text-generation', model='t5-small')
print(parap('How do I reset my API key?'))
```

maria: Paraphrases fine but annotate provenance (orig vs paraphrase vs synthetic) and keep paraphrase budget small so we don't skew intent distribution.

quant-bot: Bakeoff-run queued: 1911112222. Models queued: redwood-7b-fp32, redwood-7b-gptq, redwood-7b-awq, redwood-7b-int8, redwood-7b-fp8. Estimated runtime ~5h.

sanjay: Love it. Next actions: joel -> extract histograms & produce sampling script, maria -> assemble 2k seed tiers, eva -> synth rulebook + generation, david -> eval schema + metrics dashboard. Check back EOD. :rocket:
